tool.name: Focaloop GeneLoop adaptive genome annotation
tool.description: 5-stage adaptive eukaryotic genome annotation with homology seeding, syncmer depletion filtering, and Good-Turing UCB RNA-seq streaming
tool.command: focaloop geneloop --genome '$genome_fasta' #if $proteins_fasta --proteins '$proteins_fasta' #end if --clade '$clade' #if $exclude_genus --exclude-genus '$exclude_genus' #end if --mode '$mode' #if $tiberius_weights_dir --tiberius-weights '$tiberius_weights_dir' #end if #if $rna_manifest --rna-manifest '$rna_manifest' #end if #if $short_reads_1 --short-reads-1 #for $r in $short_reads_1 '$r' #end for --short-read-ids #for $r in $short_reads_1 '$r.element_identifier' #end for #end if #if $short_reads_2 --short-reads-2 #for $r in $short_reads_2 '$r' #end for #end if #if $long_reads --long-reads #for $r in $long_reads '$r' #end for --long-read-ids #for $r in $long_reads '$r.element_identifier' #end for #end if #if $short_bams --short-bams #for $b in $short_bams '$b' #end for #end if #if $long_bams --long-bams #for $b in $long_bams '$b' #end for #end if --logan-mode '$logan_mode' --max-frac-spots $max_frac_spots --p0-stop $p0_stop --wave-spots $wave_spots --structural-ncrna '$structural_ncrna' #if not $enable_zoom --no-zoom #end if --threads \${GALAXY_SLOTS:-8} --state-dir geneloop_state_dir --state-archive '$geneloop_state' --out-gff3 '$annotation_gff3' --out-proteins '$proteins_faa' --out-gtf '$transcripts_gtf' --out-summary '$locus_summary' --out-report '$focaloop_report'

param.name: genome_fasta
param.label: Target genome assembly (FASTA)
param.help: Target eukaryotic genome assembly in FASTA format (unmasked or soft-masked).

param.name: proteins_fasta
param.label: Homology protein sequences (RefSeq / clade FASTA, optional)
param.help: Homologous reference protein sequences aligned with miniprot for Stage-1 locus seeding.

param.name: exclude_genus
param.label: Exclude genus prefix from homology proteins (optional)

param.name: mode
param.label: Execution and compute mode
param.option: Auto-detect (GPU Tiberius -> CPU Tiberius -> Fast Evidence+Miniprot)

param.name: short_reads_1
param.label: Short-read FASTQ forward mates (R1) or single-end reads (optional)

param.name: max_frac_spots
param.label: Maximum spot fraction streamed per run

param.name: enable_zoom
param.label: Enable Stage-4 targeted micro-exon, orphan ORF, and lncRNA zoom

tool.help:
**What it does**
Runs the 5-stage **Focaloop GeneLoop** adaptive eukaryotic genome annotation loop on a target genome assembly, combining `miniprot` homology alignments, optional `Tiberius` ab initio predictions, an open-syncmer depletion filter (`glcore`), Good-Turing UCB adaptive RNA-seq streaming, and locus synthesis to emit `annotation.gff3`, `proteins.faa`, `transcripts.gtf`, `locus_summary.tsv`, a self-contained HTML report, and a `.focaloop.tar.zst` warm state archive.
